capabilities: show base query results as a transposed table with notes as columns and properties as rows
edit existing text, number, and boolean frontmatter values in cells
edit one property across all visible notes at once (Pro)
mark property rows as equal or different (Pro)
save named comparison sets and export the comparison as a Markdown note (Pro)
extras: Freemium: comparing up to five notes and single-cell edits are free; row edits, row marking, saved sets, and Markdown export require a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors payment with GitHub sign-in. After updates the plugin opens a What's new tab promoting the author's other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off). The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: It reads query results from Obsidian, so you choose notes with the native filters and sort controls.
problem: Obsidian Bases tables list each note as a row, making it hard to compare a few notes with many properties side by side.

relations.evidence: Choose Transpose as the view type in a base.

summary: Bases view type that rotates a base's table so note names span the columns and properties run down the rows, with inline property editing.
